entries.title: Ezekiel 25:1
segments: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:2
segments: Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:3
segments: And say to the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord Jehovah. So says the Lord Jehovah: Because you said, Aha, against My sanctuary when it was defiled, and against the land of Israel when it was ruined, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity;

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:4
segments: therefore, behold, I will give you to the sons of the east for a possession. And they shall set their camp sites among you, and put among you their dwellings. They shall eat your fruit, and they shall drink your milk.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:5
segments: And I will make Rabbah a pasture [for] camels, and the Ammonites a crouching-place [for] flocks. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:6
segments: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have clapped [your] hands and stamped the foot, and rejoiced in heart with all your spite against the land of Israel;

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:7
segments: behold, therefore I will stretch out My hand on you, and will give you as a prize to the nations. And I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the lands. I will destroy you, and you shall know that I [am]  the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:8
segments: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because Moab and Seir say, Behold, the house of Judah [is] like all the nations;

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:9
segments: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities, from his borders, the glory of the land, even Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:10
segments: to the men of the east with the Ammonites. And I will give them in possession so that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:11
segments: And I will execute judgments on Moab; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:12
segments: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended and revenged himself on them;

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:13
segments: therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: I will also stretch out My hand on Edom, and will cut man and beast off from it; and I will make it a waste from Teman, even to Dedan they shall fall by the sword.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:14
segments: And I will lay My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel. And they shall do in Edom according to My anger and according to My fury. And they shall know My vengeance, says the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:15
segments: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because the Philistines have taken vengeance; yes, have taken vengeance with spite in [their] soul, to destroy [with] never-ending enmity,

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:16
segments: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will stretch out My hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and will destroy the rest of the sea coast.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:17
segments: And I will execute great vengeance on them with rebukes; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I shall lay My vengeance on them.
